summary.text: John Holmberg is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 60A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Sydney Jordan (D).
He was also the Republican candidate for the seat in 2020.

paragraphs.text: John Holmberg ran for Minnesota House District 60A in the 2020 general election, in which incumbent Sydney Jordan won with 82.4 percent of the vote to his 14.6 percent.
